newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Metals Ex says in merger talks.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Metals Ex says in merger talks.

text.p: Metals Exploration Ltd said on Friday it was in talks with a third party which could result in a change in its capital structure and a change in Mid-East Minerals Ltd's interest in Metals Exploration.

"The negotiations have not reached a stage where it would be appropriate to make an announcement in relation to the proposal," Metals Exploration said in a reply to a query from the Australian Stock Exchange over the rise in its share price.
It said is anticipated that the company will be able to make an announcement by October 11. Metals Exploration earlier requested a suspension in trading in its shares.

Metals Exploration is 83 percent owned by Mid-East Minerals, which is 90 percent owned by Sir Ron Brierley's Guinness Peat Group Plc. Mid-East Minerals' main asset is its shareholding in Metals Exploration.
Metals Exploration main asset is its royalties income from nickel production at the Mount Keith and Kambalda mines, which are located in Western Australia and both operated by WMC Ltd.
A Metals Exploration spokesman said the royality income was worth between A$2.00-A$2.5 million.
Metals exploration shares last traded on Thursday at A$1.25, nine cents up on the day, while Mid-East shares last traded at 85 cents on Wednesday, up five cents on the day.
